You now have a header for your journal app.
Now you need a way to display journal entries. Each entry will have:
In this lesson, you'll build the card that displays a single entry. Right now, it'll be static, i.e., hardcoded data.
Later, you'll make it dynamic by enabling the user to enter the data themselves.
So, let's get started with our static entry card!
